collection.title: VW Passat Saloon 2002 to 2005 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a VW Passat Saloon 2002 to 2005 model which requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side anda 19" the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
